title: Marvel Super Heroes
overview:
Play as your favourite Marvel character: - Wolverine, Spider-Man, the Incredible Hulk, Captain America, Iron Man, Psylocke, Shuma-Gorath, Blackheart, Juggernaut or Magneto. Power up with an Infinity Gem - grant your super hero healing power, super attacks and increased strength.

A spectacular translation of Capcom's No.1 ranked arcade blockbuster
